title: oven-roasted algerian pork shoulder tagine
description: a light and flavorful algerian dish featuring oven-roasted pork shoulder in a floral and aromatic sauce, perfect for a lazy sunday afternoon.
instructions: Rinse the pork shoulder and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the pork shoulder with salt, pepper, and 1 tsp of the cumin, paprika, ginger, and cinnamon.
Heat 1 tbsp of the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork shoulder to a plate and set it aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil to the pot.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they're lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lemon juice, honey, and the remaining 1 tsp of cumin, paprika, ginger, and cinnamon to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the pork shoulder to the pot and cover it with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the pork shoulder for 2 1/2 hours, or until it's tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley.
Let the pork shoulder rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
